records.source: Waterfall Farm_Grandpa left you a magic lamp that grants a powerful bonus. However, you've also inherited his 1,000,000g debt to JojaBank, and must pay it off in seasonal installments...
records.translation: Bukid-Talon_Nag-iwan sa iyo si Lolo ng mahiwagang lamparang nagbibigay ng malakas na dagdag. Gayunman, minana mo rin ang utang niyang 1,000,000g sa JojaBank, at kailangan mo itong bayaran nang hulugan bawat panahon...
records.englishResidueReason: JojaBank is the in-world financial brand name.

records.source: ???: Very touching... Now, just sign the paper here...
